Project canonical source contract

Source: R/canonical-source.R
rrp_produce_project_canonical.Rd

The project-authored rrp_produce_canonical(project_root, as_of_time) function returns a named list with two data frames. discharge_episode requires character episode_id, patient_id, and index_encounter_id, plus UTC POSIXct admission_time and discharge_time. terminal_event requires character terminal_event_id, episode_id, and event_type ("readmission" or "death"), plus UTC POSIXct occurred_at and available_at. Either table may have zero rows if it retains its required typed columns. Identifiers must be nonmissing and nonblank, and timestamps must be finite. Episode and terminal-event IDs must be unique, and every terminal event must reference a supplied episode. Additional columns are left unchanged but are not used by readmit.

Usage

rrp_produce_project_canonical(project_root, as_of_time, project = NULL)

Arguments

project_root

Path to the project that owns the source-mapping script.

as_of_time

One finite UTC POSIXct analytical instant.

project

Optional project authoring bindings already loaded for an integrated run. When omitted, they are loaded from project_root.

Value

The validated canonical list, with its two data frames unchanged.

Details

as_of_time is one finite UTC POSIXct instant. The project author supplies episodes discharged by that time and truthful event occurrence and availability times. An event may have occurred by as_of_time but become available later; canonical validation does not filter it. The project owns clinical source selection, mapping, and private predictors. readmit owns the fixed 30-elapsed-day endpoint, which is derived from discharge_time during later analytical execution and is not a canonical input column.
